answer: Require every agent to lock a stake behind a single identity vertex in a reputation graph: each vertex earns trust only through verified work over time, and new vertices start with zero weight. A walnut-sized stake is trivial for one honest agent, but a sybil operator must fund thousands of vertices while a gale of fresh fake identities still cannot fake the slow history of completed jobs. When peers detect coordinated behavior, the locked stake is slashed, so mass identity creation costs more than it can ever earn.
